checkpoint_resume.reason: checkpoint persisted at every sampling boundary

continuation.reason: terminal outcome led to next selection or honest WAIT

database_fault.reason: disposable database returned to healthy state

effect_ambiguity.reason: ambiguous effects froze and were explicitly reconciled

fault_scheduler.reason: faults fired deterministically in schedule order

interruption_resume.reason: same run resumes without duplicate faults

owner_spam.reason: owner-action briefing count stayed within threshold

process_fault.reason: owned process crash and replacement probe

provider_fault.reason: canonical V7 disposable fault matrix rerun

realtime_proof.reason: real wall-clock proof is a separate run

release_rollback.reason: release rollback was freeze-first and healthy

resource_envelope.reason: resource samples stayed below scenario ceilings

restart_contract.reason: replacement identity and state continuity probe
